responsibility: Declares Xtensa uClinux-specific driver options used by the subtarget link specifications. It introduces the elf2flt switch and its joined form so the driver can request or parameterize elf2flt processing when building Xtensa uClinux binaries, complementing the LINK_SPEC logic in uclinux.h.
same_name_distinction: Unlike uclinux.h, which implements the uClinux subtarget's preprocessor and linker behavior, this file only defines the driver options elf2flt and elf2flt= so the LINK_SPEC in uclinux.h can recognize and pass them through.
